MODULE_DESCRIPTION_ATTENDANCE: Record attendance of field workers and beneficiaries at distribution sites. Ensures accurate participation tracking for operational reporting.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_CLF: Vaccinate groups of children at shared sites like schools, markets, and health posts. Capture the facility's name, type, and contact, then record deliveries and referrals against it, using an existing facility or adding a new one in the field.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_CLOSEHOUSEHOLD: Record households that were locked, unavailable, or unreachable during the round. Enables structured follow-ups and helps ensure no eligible child is missed.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_COMPLAINTS: Let field workers log issues raised by caregivers or the community during distribution—such as concerns about medicines, missed households, or service quality—to support timely follow-up and resolution.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_DELIVERY: Record household-level deliveries during the campaign. Captures delivery status, quantity, and confirmation details at the point of distribution.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_HFREFERRAL: Record and manage referrals for children who require further assessment or treatment. Capture referral reasons—such as contraindications, adverse reactions, or danger signs—and track completion at the designated health facility.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_HOUSEHOLD: Register eligible children for the campaign and capture all required demographic and caregiver details. During field visits, record the delivery and follow-up needs.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_INVENTORY: Track and update resources stock levels at each distribution point. Record receipts, issues, consumption, and losses to maintain accurate visibility of medicines across the campaign.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_PERMISSIONHANDLER: Manages user permissions needed for camera access, network usage, and device location functionality.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_REGISTRATION: Register eligible children for the campaign and capture all required demographic and caregiver details. During field visits, record the delivery and follow-up needs.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_REGISTRATION-DELIVERY: Register beneficiaries for bednet distribution campaigns & record household-level bednet deliveries during the campaign.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_STOCKRECONCILIATION: Compare reported stock against expected balances at the end of each day or round. Identify discrepancies and validate inventory data to maintain accurate resources accounting.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_STOCKREPORTS: Access summary and detailed stock reports for analysis across facilities, CHWs, and rounds. Supports monitoring of consumption, balances, and losses throughout the campaign.
MODULE_DESCRIPTION_TRANSITPOST: Deliver vaccines at transit points like bus stations and border crossings, where children pass through and aren't pre-registered. Capture the post's type, name, and location, then record deliveries and referrals for each session.
